scope: public compact dryRun planning and compact including durable archive rewrite; setup/load, snapshots, hashes and second compact are untimed

memoryMeasurement.heapAllocationDeltaBytes: sampled peak heapUsed minus heapUsed after global.gc(); lower bound, not total allocated bytes
memoryMeasurement.peakSampledRssBytes: per-run sampled RSS, including shared process/module/fixture memory

limitations: no official host domain transaction, fsync or multi-process
synthetic fixed-time corpus, not production user data
OS page cache is not flushed
knowledge groups fit the bounded sourceRefs window; canonical protects outcomes, not terminal promotions
order: each baseline/variant pair uses A/B in even rounds and B/A in odd rounds: A/B/B/A across two rounds; samples repeat this order
